forces.name: guide spring at the post
forces.model: lift spring 12.0 N m/rad preloaded 4 deg (LIFT_K, LIFT_PRE)
forces.set: turn the M8 screw under the spring until the check below reads right
forces.check: bar drawn and straight, stirrup off: spring scale under the post, pulled straight down: the post starts to leave its notch at about 26 N (15 N of it the bar's front-heavy weight, 11 N the spring) and is clear (5 mm down) at about 37 N

forces.name: lift to unlock
forces.value: 7 N to start, 9 N at release
forces.model: follows from the spring and the masses
forces.check: stirrup unfolded, bar locked straight: spring scale on the arm 115 mm above the roll pin, pulled straight up

forces.name: draw
forces.value: about 5 to 8 N (estimate: the post pressed on the groove's ceiling, friction 0.3)
forces.set: PTFE tape on the groove's ceiling if it reads high
forces.check: spring scale on the clevis, pulled along the bar, steady

forces.name: bar assembly mass
forces.value: 0.60 kg (steel bar 0.54 kg, T-rail and spacers 0.06 kg)

checks: open stop screw at s 6.17 mm, h 8.05 mm from the roll pin: it first meets the bar's top face at 100.0 deg (stop angle 100 deg); folded it clears the bar by 3.38 mm
boss below the bar: cheek tops 135.50 mm, trunnion and lips up to 136.32 mm, bar underside 136.82 mm; the folded stirrup lies on the bar's top face at 143.17 mm
T-rail over the window's lower edge with the bar at -3 deg: 5.38 mm
spring: 2.13 N/mm, preload 11.2 N = 5.2 mm; at full lift 15.7 mm of 38.1 mm free length
spring tower reaches 86.7 mm from the axis; the support rail starts 100.0 mm behind it
